<?php
$o = new class {
    public int $ready = 3;
    public int $pending;
    public function __unset(string $name): void {
        echo "UNSET:", $name, ";";
    }
};
unset($o->ready, $o->pending);
echo "BYPASS;";
unset($o->virtual);
unset($o->absent);
echo "AFTER;";

<?php
$o = new class {
    public function __unset(string $name): void {
        global $o;
        echo "ENTER:", $name, ";";
        unset($o->missing);
        echo "LEAVE;";
    }
};
unset($o->missing);
echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class MissingUnsetProbe {
    public function __destruct() {
        global $o;
        echo "LOCAL;";
        unset($o->missing);
        echo "LOCAL-DONE;";
    }
}
$o = new class {
    public function __unset(string $name): void {
        $probe = new MissingUnsetProbe;
        echo "ENTER:", $name, ";";
    }
};
unset($o->missing);
echo "AFTER;";
